course_products.heading: Edstellar Products That Extend Your Training
course_products.text: {course} can sit inside a wider capability plan. Alongside its instructor-led programs, Edstellar offers seven products that find skill gaps, run learning, assess leaders and keep teams improving after the training ends.

products.name: TNA/TNI Engine
products.text: Runs the full training needs analysis and identification cycle, from raw employee data to a prioritized training roadmap and calendar.

facts.text: Self, manager, assessment, interview and focus-group evidence behind every need
Needs ranked by gap, criticality and headcount
A TNA report, roadmap, calendar and individual development plans at the end of one cycle

products.tagline: Training needs analysis software, backed by evidence.

products.name: Capability OS
products.text: AI drafts skills and competency frameworks, people approve them, and evidence from several sources validates each skill, level by level.

facts.text: A skill counts as validated only when at least two independent sources agree
Three-tier human approval, with every edit logged
41 indices across nine capability domains, plus an employee Skill Passport

products.tagline: One verified picture of what your organization can do.

products.name: Zenith
products.text: A leadership assessment and development center for high-potential identification, led end to end by Edstellar consultants.

facts.text: Psychometrics, 360-degree feedback and live exercises in one leadership view
Succession readiness, high-potentials and capability gaps, on evidence
Pathways from diagnostics to curriculum, coaching, mentoring and job shadowing

products.name: Orbit
products.text: Collects anonymous feedback from several rater groups; AI drafts each report and an Edstellar consultant reviews it before release.

facts.text: 45, 90, 180, 270 and 360-degree feedback formats
Up to six rater groups, with anonymity built in
Development tracked from one feedback round to the next

products.tagline: Build self-awareness and turn feedback into focused development.

products.name: Polaris
products.text: A facilitator-led, structured session that surfaces what a team has been avoiding and turns it into a commitment the team owns.

facts.text: Intact teams of 6 to 12 people, in one 3 to 4 hour virtual session
Private written responses before anyone speaks
A 30-day check-in booked before the session ends

products.name: Meridian
products.text: One-on-one leadership coaching: each leader gets a certified coach, a structured track and 10 to 12 virtual sessions.

facts.text: Coaches recommended against the leader's objective, focus areas and style
A free 30-minute chemistry session before committing to a coach
The leader decides what the organization sees

products.tagline: One coach, one leader, one conversation at a time.
